pages.heading: Froststalker
pages.body: Ice Spikes and Frozen Peaks. Hostile pack hunter that freezes water underfoot and can shed damaging ice shards. Its horn makes a disguise helmet, but attacking

pages.heading: Froststalker (cont.)
pages.body: the pack breaks your cover. Breed with porkchops while wearing the helmet. Warm biomes weaken it and melt its spikes.
